Hero Public Safety Commission.text: The government body that runs the hero system. It writes the rules for hero work, issues and revokes hero licenses, runs the Provisional Hero License Exam and coordinates heroes with the police. It also manages how the public sees heroes: it releases incident statistics, handles press relations and presents the twice-yearly Hero Billboard Chart JP, which ranks heroes by incidents resolved, public approval and social contribution. Its tower in central Tokyo is quiet, efficient and closed to visitors beyond the licensing counter. Heroes depend on it and rarely love it; to most citizens it is a seal on a license. The visible contradiction: a public-safety agency that worries about approval ratings as much as about safety.
